News Items 
 
Draft Litter Management Plan 2025-2027 
Kildare County Council is inviting submissions on the Draft Litter Management Plan 
2025-2027, which is now open for public consultation (see page 9). 
 
Athy Welcomes Senator Bernie Sanders and Jane Sanders for a Historic Visit 
On Sunday, 25 May 2025, the town of Athy had the distinct honour of welcoming 
U.S. Senator Bernie Sanders and Jane Sanders. The visit was part of the "Made of 
Athy" series, celebrating the rich cultural heritage and history of the town  
(see page 9/10). 
 
VECTOR Digital Arts Residency Open Studio  
On Thursday, 22 May colleagues from the County Council and local art world were 
invited to the open studio of 1iing Heaney at MERITS as part of the new VECTOR 
Digital Arts Residency initiated by Kildare Arts Service (see page 13). 
 
Budget 2026 
It is envisaged that there will be a property revaluation for 2026 Local Property Tax 
(LPT) liability and Revenue will have to be notified of the decision on variation of the 
Local Property Tax (LPT) by 31 August 2025, therefore a decision will need to be 
made by the Members at the July council meeting on 28 July 2025. LPT public 
consultation has been advertised and is ongoing from 03 June to 04 July 2025 (see 
page 17). 
 
Homeless Outreach Clinics 
The Housing Department is continuing to hold monthly homeless outreach 
information clinics across the county.  Details are published on social media. The 
Homeless Section can be contacted at 045 980230.  Clinics are taking place in 
Maynooth, Kildare Town, Athy, Newbridge, Curragh and Celbridge (see page 18).

Relocation of Beneficiaries of Temporary Protection in State Accommodation 
With the declining demand for accommodation for people fleeing the war in Ukraine 
some existing accommodation centres across the country will be closing, returning to 
their original use or an alternative use. This will result in the relocation of existing 
residents to alternative accommodation (see page 31). 
 
Community Climate Action Program Fund 
Twenty-four projects were approved by the Department of Environment, Climate and 
Communications (DECC) for the Community Climate Action Fund Grant. Grantees 
have 18 months to complete the projects and since the grants were finalised in 
September, ten of the projects have been completed (see page 48). 
 
Erasmus+ Repower Regions 
Kildare County Council, in collaboration with twelve European partners, continues to 
progress the Erasmus+ Repower Regions project, which aims to strengthen regional 
cooperation and skills development in the heating and cooling sector. Partners have 
moved further into the interview and case study stages, with best practice insights 
shared at the most recent Management Committee meeting on 03 June (see pages 
79/80).

Affordable Housing 
The application portal for affordable housing units at Lattin Place closes on Friday, 
20 June.. Assessment of applications is underway (see page 18). 
 
Designated Accommodation Centres (DAC’s) 
The Integration Team hold Day-75 Clinics in the Punchestown DAC on a fortnightly 
basis to assist residents with the sourcing and matching of accommodation. A clinic 
was held on 28 May 2025 with further clinic scheduled for 01 July 2025 (see page 
39). 
 
Entente Florale 2025 
Kildare County Council is supporting the nomination of Maynooth in the Large Town 
Category for the Entente Florale Europe Competition in 2025. Judging will take place 
on 12 July (see page 51). 
 
Gum Litter Roadshow 
A Gum Litter Roadshow will be held in Newbridge on 16 July. The roadshow is 
interactive and educational, and aims to raise awareness about the environmental 
and fiscal impacts of gum litter (see page 53). 
 
Outdoor Recreation Strategy 
An online public consultation to ascertain the publics input into the outdoor recreation 
strategy and sports strategy has been advertised. Link to the survey is 
https://forms.office.com/e/DthKMaSPAD The survey is open until 27 June (see page 
64). 
 
Focus On Women In Business 
The next She Succeeds event takes place on 24 June and focuses on mastering 
financial terminology and concepts (see page 78).

Service. 1iing has been working at

2025.

decided not to award the contract for 
PPP Bundle 3 which involved the 
construction of 486 homes nationally, 
including our site at Ardrew, Athy (73

contract was made following a cost

new procurement and delivery 
strategy.
